identity.description: Generative probabilistic topic model over count data: documents are mixtures of K latent topics, topics are distributions over the vocabulary, with Dirichlet priors on both simplices and a multinomial word likelihood fit by variational Bayes. Emits a per-row topic mixture. (Latent Dirichlet allocation — NOT LinearDiscriminantAnalysis, which shares the acronym.)

dtypes: nonnegative integer counts (document-term / entity-event count matrix, sparse ok)
consumes.note: counts are the sufficient statistics of the multinomial likelihood — tf-idf or other real-valued weightings violate the generative model

emits.note: transform(X) returns theta_d — the per-document distribution over K topics (rows sum to 1); itself a probability vector
components_ — the K x vocab topic-word distributions (the topics themselves), the fitted knowledge a labeling/summarization step consumes

portTypeProposal.name: topic-word-dists
portTypeProposal.carries: K x vocabulary matrix of per-topic term distributions
portTypeProposal.wiringConsequence: doc-topic mixtures (docs x K) and topic-word distributions (K x vocab) are NOT interchangeable: a downstream classifier consumes per-doc mixtures as features; a topic-labeling component consumes topic-word dists. Overloading one `topic-mixture` port for both shapes makes an illegal wiring look legal — U2 should rule SAME (granularity disambiguates) vs DISTINCT.

n_components.note: K, the number of topics — the load-bearing choice; coherence-vs-K is the honest selector

doc_topic_prior.note: alpha; sklearn default None -> 1/n_components. Small alpha -> sparse per-doc mixtures

topic_word_prior.note: eta; sklearn default None -> 1/n_components. Small eta -> sparse, crisp topics

learning_method.note: optimization regime, not a statistical choice; online for corpora too large for batch E-steps

max_iter.note: convergence budget, not a searchable statistical knob

invariances.why: the multinomial likelihood is defined over integer event counts; rescaling (e.g. tf-idf) changes the pseudo-counts entering the variational updates and breaks the generative semantics
log/sqrt of counts alters the multinomial sufficient statistics — the raw counts ARE the model, so any transform changes the fit
an absent term is a ZERO count, not missing; a literal NaN has no count interpretation and the variational E-step cannot process it
consumes a numeric count matrix, not raw tokens/categories — count-vectorization upstream is what converts categorical events into the sufficient statistics
fully generative: Dirichlet priors on both the doc-topic and topic-word simplices, multinomial word likelihood, and bag-of-words exchangeability (order discarded)
theta_d posterior concentration grows with tokens per document and topic-word estimates with corpus size; short-text corpora (tweets) are the known weak regime
fold-in inference on new documents is confined to the fitted vocabulary and the K-simplex; out-of-vocabulary terms carry exactly zero information

featureStats.why: theta_d's posterior concentrates at rate governed by document length; very short rows yield near-prior mixtures — the short-text regime where LDA is known to underperform
topic-word estimates need enough occurrences per term; a huge sparse vocabulary spreads counts too thin — flags min_df/max_df pruning upstream
floats or negatives (tf-idf, standardized input) violate the multinomial count assumption — the single most common silent misuse of this model

modelMetrics.why: exp of negative held-out log-likelihood per token — the model's own generative scoreboard, but it anti-correlates with human topic quality, so it must be paired with coherence
coherence scores the co-occurrence consistency of each topic's top terms — the interpretability lens perplexity misses; low-coherence topics are statistical artifacts, not patterns

edgeCases.behavior: sklearn errors on negatives but SILENTLY accepts non-integer floats, corrupting the count semantics

edgeCases.condition: n_components far above the corpus's effective pattern count
edgeCases.note: coherence-vs-K sweep selects K; don't gate — over-K is recoverable

edgeCases.behavior: per-doc mixtures collapse toward the Dirichlet prior; unstable topics across seeds
transform silently returns the bare prior as the mixture — a fabricated-looking output

driver.wrapperNeeds: modest: enforce the nonnegative-integer count contract at the input boundary (CountVectorizer-style upstream, never tf-idf); transform -> per-row topic-mixture; expose components_ (topic-word dists) as the per-model artifact; persist the vocabulary/column mapping with the model so fold-in aligns columns; keep the registry key distinct from LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
driver.threadSafety: n_jobs-parallel variational E-step; transform is thread-safe

placementClaims.why: a valid count matrix encodes absence as zero; literal NaNs indicate a broken vectorization to reject upstream, not a value to impute
log/tf-idf transforms destroy the integer-count sufficient statistics of the multinomial likelihood — the canonical misuse
standardization produces negative values the model rejects outright, and rescaling corrupts count semantics even where it runs
raw tokens/categorical events must be count-vectorized into the document-term matrix — the encode stage IS the construction of the model's sufficient statistics
